answer: Grading junk as passing is therefore a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. The ledge panel is drawn blind, the sonnet escrow settles at close, and grove lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 10% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 57 account operation therefore ties up 32 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
